callouts.id: 分部求和的想法,Dirichlet-Abel收敛判别法的推广#1
callouts.title: 对Dirichlet判别的扩展
callouts.body:
1.  原本的判别当中，依旧保持$\left|B_N\right|<\infty$对任意的正整数$N$成立,但是把$a_n$单调收敛到0替换为，$a_n$有界变差收敛到0。(参考[[对Dirichlet判别的一个调整]])
2.  如果$$|a_n - a_{n+1}| = O\left(\frac{1}{n^{M+1}}\right)$$这个时候其实不需要给到$\left|B_N\right|<\infty$如此强的条件的，想要$\sum_{n=1}^{N-1}B_n(a_n-a_{n+1})$绝对收敛实际上只需要$$B_n =O(n^{M-\varepsilon_0})$$因此原来的级数一定是收敛的。
3. 如果我们知道$a_n$是单调的，并且$$|a_n - a_{n+1}| \gg \frac{1}{n^{M+1}},B_n\gg n^{M}$$同时假设$B_na_n$的极限是存在的，那么由于$$B_n|a_{n}-a_{n+1}|\gg \frac{1}{n}$$因此原来的级数一定是发散的。

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Summation by parts extensions of the Dirichlet test
if_strategy_template.summary_en: Use summation by parts to replace the classical monotone-to-zero assumption in the Dirichlet test by weaker hypotheses such as bounded variation, or to trade decay of differences \(|a_n-a_{n+1}|\) against growth bounds on partial sums \(B_n\). The same framework can also give divergence criteria when the summation-by-parts remainder is too large.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies to series of the form \(\sum a_n b_n\) when one has information on the partial sums \(B_n=\sum_{k=1}^n b_k\) and on the variation or discrete derivative of \(a_n\).

callouts.id: 分部求和的想法,Dirichlet-Abel收敛判别法的推广#2
callouts.title: 问题1
callouts.body:
假设$\sum_{j = 1}^{n} a_j = o\left(\sqrt{n}\right)$,证明：
$$\sum_{j} \frac{a_j}{j}$$ 收敛

classification_result.id: 分部求和的想法,Dirichlet-Abel收敛判别法的推广#2

if_problem.statement_en:
Assume that \(\sum_{j=1}^{n} a_j = o\left(\sqrt{n}\right)\). Prove that
\[
\sum_j \frac{a_j}{j}
\]
converges.
